indicator_name: Dollarisation: foreign-currency share of bank loans, business loans and household deposits (computed by this repository)
description: Долларизация: доля кредитов банков, кредитов бизнесу и вкладов населения в иностранной валюте (расчёт репозитория)
methodology: Shares of the NBK's stocks, as at the 1st of the month: LOANS_FX_SHARE = BANK_LOANS_STB_FX / BANK_LOANS_STB_TOTAL (from 1996); BUSINESS_LOANS_FX_SHARE = LOANS_BUSINESS_FX / (FX + KZT) (from 2022, banks and other lenders); HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_FX_SHARE = the three HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_*_FX over all six household deposit series (from 2023); the term-deposit share separately. The stocks are in tenge, so a depreciation raises the share without any conversion (valuation effect). DEPOSITS_FX_SHARE, LEGAL_ENTITY_DEPOSITS_FX_SHARE and INDIVIDUALS_DEPOSITS_FX_SHARE are from DEPOSITS_BY_CURRENCY (the depository-organisations page, from 1998: 68.8 % of all deposits at 2016-01-01, 18.7 % at 2026-10-01); that page counts all deposits of individuals, the HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_* scalars a narrower set, hence 14.3 % against 17.9 %. The regulator's own household figure is BANK_DEPOSITS_INDIVIDUALS_FX_SHARE (ARDFM, from 2026-05).
